godot_omni.note: Owned by the Godot editor plugin (addons/godot_ai + addons/godot_omni). Loki reads the editor's per-launch capability token and connects over HTTP; it must NOT spawn godot-ai itself or the two fight over ports 8000/9500 and kill the editor.

godot_runtime.note: 39 tools: launch/run/attach a project and read debug output.

godot_enhanced.note: 26 tools: runtime, screenshots and script/scene validation.

ruflo.note: Ruflo (github.com/ruvnet/ruflo, MIT): swarm, memory and agent tools. Opt in with LOKI_MCP_ENABLE=ruflo.

penecho.note: PenEcho (github.com/penecho/penecho, AGPL-3.0, a separate program): shared drawing canvas on http://localhost:3888. Starts when penecho is installed (npm i -g penecho) and turned on in Settings > Add-ons, or with LOKI_MCP_ENABLE=penecho.

openhuman.note: OpenHuman (github.com/tinyhumansai/openhuman, GPL-3.0, a separate program): stdio MCP server. Starts when openhuman-core is on PATH and turned on in Settings > Add-ons, or with LOKI_MCP_ENABLE=openhuman.

cadcraft.note: CADCraft (github.com/storytold/cadcraft, MIT OR Apache-2.0, a separate program): AutoCAD-style 2D drafting (DXF/DWG, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks) driven by LOKI's agents over MCP - command_line, execute, inspect_drawing, query_entities, render. Install: python tools/setup_extras.py cadcraft; turn on in Settings > Add-ons, or LOKI_MCP_ENABLE=cadcraft.

blender.note: MCP for Blender (github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender, MIT), pinned to the vendored add-on's commit febcd90 - server and add-on must speak the same protocol (15). Starts when Blender is installed on this machine; the add-on (contrib/blender_mcp, installed by `python engine/blender_link.py setup`) listens on 9876 while Blender is open. Telemetry off, paid generators never switched on.

blender_dcc.note: dcc-mcp-blender (github.com/loonghao/dcc-mcp-blender, MIT): ~205 typed Blender tools (mesh, UV, rigging, materials, render). Needs its own Blender extension installed; Blender 5.x support unverified. Opt in with LOKI_MCP_ENABLE=blender_dcc after LOKI_TASKS checks it on the PC.

mobile.note: mobile-mcp (github.com/mobile-next/mobile-mcp, Apache-2.0), pinned so the Mac and the PC run the same one. Tests apps on iOS simulators (Mac, Xcode), Android emulators and phones (PC, adb). Starts only when a device is reachable (engine/mobile_test.py; LOKI_MOBILE_MCP=on forces it). Screenshots are of the phone only. Telemetry off.

openpencil.note: OpenPencil's MCP server (github.com/open-pencil/open-pencil, MIT): edits the design open in the OpenPencil desktop app live. It only works while the app is open, so it starts only then (design.app_running). Without the app LOKI's own `design` tool does the same work headlessly on designs/*.fig (engine/design.py).
